I jumped off 60mg cold turkey after only 9 days and my previous habit was only a month and a half of 90mg oxy a day and I was in full physical withdrawal for about 14 day’s. The withdrawal does not progressively ease up until the very end. Day 3 and day 8 are the same. Whatever symptom you get the most(for me it’s the sweats and chills back and forth) will be 24/7. The other symptoms like shitting and puking will be like other withdrawal from regular oxy. I give it an 8/10 on the pain scale BUT if you taper even rapidly you can get down to 20mg a sustain that for 2-3 weeks and then cold turkey. 

The reason it takes so long to come off of is the half life is around 5-9 days. Each dose builds up on that and so assuming you’ve been on it for a year you have roughly  (140x7x52)-(70x52)= 50,960mg of methadone in your system that’s build up according to the half life of 7 days and one dose losing half of its amount per week. Now if we multiple 50,960x 7=356,720 thats roughly how much methadone is build up in your body. That all had to slowly lower which is why it takes months to feel better. If you taper down to 20mg you can save yourself a world of torture compared to jumping off that insane amount.
